Policy Name: Cigna ACDF (CMM-601: Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion)
Referred Sections: CMM-601.4: Initial Primary Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (ACDF)

Required findings: Both symptoms present: (1) clinically significant daily pain causing functional impairment (e.g., inability to perform household chores, prolonged standing) AND (2) unremitting radicular pain to the shoulder girdle and/or upper extremity resulting in disability

Any one of the following objective physical exam findings: dermatomal sensory deficit; motor deficit (biceps or triceps weakness); reflex changes; shoulder abduction relief sign; nerve root tension sign (e.g., Spurling's maneuver); or unremitting radicular pain without concordant objective findings

MRI or CT demonstrating neural structure compression at the requested level(s) that correlates with symptoms and exam, caused by herniated disc (including retained or recurrent disc material), synovial or arachnoid cyst, central/lateral/foraminal stenosis, or osteophytes

Failure to achieve clinically meaningful improvement after at least two of the following conservative measures (unless contraindicated) for a minimum of six weeks: prescription‑strength analgesics/steroids/gabapentinoids/NSAIDs; provider‑directed exercise program prescribed by PT, chiropractor, or physician; epidural steroid injection or selective nerve root block at the same level(s); plain cervical spine x‑rays including flexion/extension lateral views

Absence of unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorders (e.g., major depressive disorder, chronic pain syndrome, secondary gain, opioid or alcohol use disorder) and documented nicotine‑free status (never‑smoker or abstinent ≥6 weeks with objective cotinine test within normal range)

Non-Indications: Patient lacks either of the two required symptom criteria (significant daily pain with functional impairment OR unremitting radicular pain to shoulder/upper extremity)
No qualifying physical exam finding documented
Imaging does not show compression at the proposed level or shows compression due to causes not listed (e.g., tumor, infection)
Patient has not completed at least two required conservative therapies for six weeks (unless medically contraindicated)
Presence of unmanaged significant mental or behavioral health disorder
Current smoker or nicotine use documented without six‑week abstinence verified by cotinine testing
Plain cervical spine x‑rays (including flexion/extension) not performed
Important criteria & exceptions: Both symptom elements must be present; a single symptom alone is insufficient
Only one objective physical exam finding is required; multiple findings strengthen the case but are not mandatory
Conservative therapy requirement may be waived only if a documented medical contraindication exists for the specific modality
Nicotine‑free verification can be satisfied by never‑smoker status or by objective cotinine testing demonstrating abstinence for ≥6 weeks
Behavioral health disorders must be documented as managed; unmanaged conditions constitute a denial
Documentation required: Comprehensive history note describing daily pain severity, functional impairment, and unremitting radicular pain to shoulder/upper extremity
Physical examination note documenting at least one of the listed objective findings
Prescription records or medication administration logs confirming use of prescription‑strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, or NSAIDs for a minimum of six weeks
Physical therapy, chiropractic, or physician‑directed exercise program notes confirming six‑week duration
Procedure reports for epidural steroid injection(s) or selective nerve root block(s) performed at the same level(s)
Plain cervical spine radiographs including flexion and extension lateral views
MRI or CT report showing neural compression at the surgical level with etiology (herniated disc, cyst, stenosis, osteophyte, etc.)
Mental health assessment or psychiatric evaluation confirming absence of unmanaged significant mental/behavioral health disorders
Smoking history documentation and objective cotinine test result (serum, urine, or saliva) within normal range if not a never‑smoker
